summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a routine quarterly dividend declaration by Benchmark Electronics. The board declared a $0.17 per share dividend payable on July 10, 2026 to shareholders of record June 30, 2026. No other special-situation elements are present. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return beyond ordinary dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The dividend is a routine recurring event with no structural nuance or risk-arb angle. Hence it falls outside any special-situation category.
